description: Procurement for the Designing, Developing, Printing and Supplying of Computerized Draw Lottery Tickets for Development Lotteries Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Bids have been invited following the National Competitive Bidding procedure for the procurement of Designing, Developing, Printing and Supplying of Computerized Draw Lottery Tickets (Lagna Wasana, Kapruka, Ada Kotipathi, Super Ball, Sasiri, Shanida, Supiri Dhana Sampatha, New Lottery, and Jaya Sampatha) as well as the provision of E-Lottery services to the Development Lotteries Board for a period of one year. Four (04) bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendations made by the High Level Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board following the evaluation of the said bids, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to award the relevant procurements to the substantially responsive lowest bidders as follows, was approved by the Cabinet:
